_comment: Curated stereoisomer fold map — PREP DATA, not yet consumed by the build. Seeds `_ISOMER_FAMILIES` for Specs/stereoisomer-and-release-form-axes.md Stage A: each variant folds into its `parent` as one substance with an isomer selector (e.g. Ketamine is one entry; Esketamine is its S-isomer, not a separate row). Auto-derived by pipeline/audit/overlay_lib.py isomer_families() from InChIKey connectivity-block clusters, then hand-vetted. `isomer` = stored stereo code (drives dedup); `displayName` = the recognized name shown in the picker title. When fold_isomer_families() lands it should read this file (or transcribe it into sqlite.py), fold each variant under the parent, tag the moved dose/duration rows with the isomer code, and keep variant names + brands as aliases.

excluded.reason: Genuine enantiomers, but they currently share an EXACT (identical) InChIKey MKXZASYAUGDDCJ-CGTJXYLNSA-N — one is corrupt. Fix the identifier first (they must differ in the stereo layer), then fold; there is also no racemic parent row.
Protonation states (charge layer N vs O), not stereoisomers. Serotonin(1+) is the cation, not a chiral variant; likely chemistry-noise that should not be a separate row.
Mescaline is achiral (no stereocenter); the '4-D'/'beta-D' rows are truncated/garbled names carrying spurious stereo layers. Investigate the names, not a fold.
Obscure AMPAkine research compounds; relationship (enantiomer vs regioisomer) unconfirmed. Needs a human call before folding.
